text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, famotidine 20 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale Lakeside holds 14 units with 8.4 days on hand. Corvale General holds 256.9 units with 26.4 days on hand. Corvale East holds 229 units with 23.5 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): The product label at all three sites is from Northwind Health Company, LLC (NDC 51655031220, SPL set ID ab1cdbbf-d838-020c-e053-2995a90a0f65). The registered plant is Northwind Health Company, LLC (FEI 1831143) in the USA performing REPACK operations. FDA inspection 952157 of Northwind Pharmaceuticals LLC (FEI 1831143) ended 2015-12-09, classified OAI, known date 2016-03-08. The most recent FDA inspection 1256379 ended 2025-09-26, classified VAI, known date 2025-12-04.

Our position: No national shortage exists. The risk is local to Corvale Lakeside. Corvale General and Corvale East have sufficient stock to support a transfer without dropping below two weeks on hand.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 10 units from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 10 units from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside — needs pharmacy director (transfer request).

Not recommended: Purchasing from A-S Medication Solutions, Advanced Rx Pharmacy of Tennessee, LLC, or Advanced Rx of Tennessee, LLC. None are on the FDA shortage list today and their labels name no plant we could verify.
